title: Metric k-median strictly below factor two
exact_target: Is there one absolute $\sigma >0$ and a randomized polynomial-bit-time algorithm for arbitrary finite rational metric k-median that opens at most k facilities and achieves ratio $2-\sigma $ in expectation and with failure probability at most $(|clients|+|facilities|+2)^{-a}$ for any prescribed fixed $a>0$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
